Karthikeyan is already well known in the world of chess for his stunning wins against Firouzja and Carlsen in classical chess! He is now playing at the 1st Chola Chess Open GM 2026 and his opponent was the young and talented IM from Bangalore Apoorv Kamble. Check out this game and the incredible combination that Karthikeyan found! Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
